author: Neuralink
description:
ALS is a disease that takes everything. Our goal is to give something back. 

Ken, who has been losing his ability to move and speak due to ALS, is exploring how Neuralink’s brain-computer interface technology can help translate neural signals into life-changing impact. 

See how this is possible: https://youtu.be/u8mmn9lOIyw
Join the Neuralink mission! Apply at https://neuralink.com/careers

Note: Neuralink devices are investigational and are not commercially available or FDA approved. There are no guaranteed benefits from participating in a Neuralink clinical trial.
title: Restoring Speech With Real-Time Telepathy
